name: Pika API Club
desc: Membership API bundling a hundred plus media models
desc_zh: 打包上百个媒体模型的会员制 API
solves: Comparing five providers meant five accounts and five invoices; one membership reaches the models through one key.
solves_zh: 对比五家供应商就要五个账号、五张账单；一个会员资格用同一把 key 调用这些模型。
best_for: A prototype needs video, image and audio from three different labs; join the Club and call them from one endpoint.
best_for_zh: 原型要同时用三家实验室的视频、图片和音频；加入 Club，从一个接口调用。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://pika.art/blog (post "Welcome to the Pika API Club")）。 An API membership platform, distinct from the Pika app the ledger already has. The blog post itself 404s; the date and the description come from Pika's own blog index, which lists the entry under "New Release". No independent press source opened. 首次公开日期来源：https://pika.art/blog
